bladeCount.title: Blade Count
bladeCount.description: Blade slots the job needs, e.g. 2

customerName.title: Customer Name
customerName.description: Optional customer the job is for, e.g. Samsung; applies that customer's data-residency rule

durationDays.title: Duration Days
durationDays.description: Optional duration in days when no end date is given; blank means 30

locationName.title: Location Name
locationName.description: Optional colo name to limit the search, e.g. San Jose

powerKw.title: Power Kw
powerKw.description: Optional total power in kW; leave blank to estimate 20 kW per blade

region.title: Region
region.description: Optional region to limit the search: US-West, US-Central, EU-Germany, APAC-India, APAC-Korea, APAC-Taiwan, or a broad geography US, EU or APAC

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Optional start date YYYY-MM-DD; blank means today
